item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "69cbeb67c82f24226fdbf3df9959f3e127b28272b7f7094d9e2c935db3586c54",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For a function q : ℝ × ℝ → E into a real normed vector space and a real speed c, requires LocalDef004(q,c,x,t) at every real x,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Under differentiability of the profile, asserts existence of both partial derivatives everywhere and the equation q_t + c q_x = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Requires interval integrability of every spatial slice of q, interval integrability of every temporal trace of flux composed with q, and, for all real a,b,s,t, the identity ∫_a^b q(x,t) dx − ∫_a^b q(x,s) dx = ∫_s^t [flux(q(a,τ)) − flux(q(b,τ))] dτ, using the specified real volume measure and oriented interval integrals.",
      "effect_on_target": "The final conditional conclusion includes all three requirements, with q(x,t)=profile(x−speed·t) and flux(z)=speed·z.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Defines q(x,t)=profile(x−speed·t), for any profile from ℝ to E.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the function in every conclusion explicitly; q is not an independently quantified solution.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "At a fixed x,t, there exist qt,qx in E such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + speed • qx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the differential equation require actual partial derivatives. In the target E=ℝ, scalar multiplication is real multiplication; the witnesses may depend on profile, speed, x and t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Every real normed vector space has continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity instance needed for derivative predicates in the local definitions; adds no assumption on the profile.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the additive commutative monoid structure of an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real module structure without changing addition or zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group structure from an additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the underlying real additive group operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts an additive group's additive monoid, negation and subtraction structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real subtraction and the additive instance hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero and the additive identity laws from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the zero-compatible additive structure used by scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished zero from an addition-with-zero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the same real zero used in the structural instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts addition and zero from a structure asserting additive identity laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and zero in the instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both component propositions hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all five top-level clauses and every component within the local predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Obtains a nontrivially normed field from a densely normed field while preserving its normed field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes ℝ an admissible scalar field for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Differentiable",
      "meaning": "A function is differentiable over the specified scalar field at every point of its domain.",
      "effect_on_target": "The fourth clause assumes real differentiability of profile at every real input; it does not assume continuity of the derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar action used by differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication preserving zero from distributive scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar operation in the real module instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations for the module structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "All stated equalities are exact; the profile identities and differential equation are pointwise equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the commutative division semiring structure of a field, including its existing operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar structure on ℝ without imposing a restriction on speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation supplied by a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "In the target this is real addition, including x+speed·t and qt+speed·qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "HMul.hMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplication operation supplied by a heterogeneous multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "In the target this is real multiplication in translations and the flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified derivative at the specified point, using the neighborhood filter at that point with the base point fixed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts ordinary real derivatives at all real times along characteristics and actual partial derivatives in LocalDef004, with no one-sided domain restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector space structure from an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real normed vector space structure on the real-valued functions' codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "A function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the given measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Handles either order of the endpoints. Universal interval integrability does not require integrability over all of ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology provides continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of the real scalar action required by HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring has the corresponding topological semiring property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the derivation of the continuous real scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring acting on itself has the module topology property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects real ring topology to the continuity instance used by derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure from a measure-space instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrability statements and integrals use the measure selected by Real.measureSpace; no measure is universally quantified.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive multiplicative scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar multiplication used by the derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid structure of a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports multiplication of real scalars in the module instance hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital commutative ring operations while dropping the requirement of associativity from the resulting structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a weaker structural interface for real ring topology without altering operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital nonassociative ring structure, forgetting the commutativity field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the algebraic interface for the real topological ring instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital commutative ring operations from a normed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed ring instance to the ring topology hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital seminormed ring structure, forgetting commutativity as a supplied field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real seminormed additive structure used by differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group and compatible pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real additive norm and topology needed for normed vector space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field structure of a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real field operations and norm throughout the calculus instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed additive group structure while forgetting commutativity as an explicit field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the extended norm structure used for real integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, addition and pseudometric of a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the seminormed additive interface for ℝ as a normed vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with its associated continuous extended nonnegative norm and additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the norm structure in IntervalIntegrable for real-valued profiles.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's operations, norm and metric while omitting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological ring instance chain without changing any operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, ring operations and induced pseudometric of a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real seminormed structures used in the explicit calculus types.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying field of a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real field algebra for scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed field's commutative ring, norm and metric structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real normed ring interface used by the topology and calculus instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar multiplication in differentiability and derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal using its designated instance in the target type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the displayed zero literals as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real distance structure to the topology used in derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Equips an RCLike field with its real inner product space structure and underlying real normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "At ℝ, supplies its real normed vector space structure; the target remains real-valued.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The type of real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "The profile values, speed, spatial coordinates, times, integration endpoints and derivative witnesses are all real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The densely normed field structure on ℝ, built from Real.normedField.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar field hypotheses for ordinary real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The addition instance whose operation is real addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the additions in characteristic coordinates and equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group instance on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies additive algebra required by calculus and real normed structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "The multiplication instance whose operation is real multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines speed·t and the linear flux speed·state.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The RCLike structure on ℝ, with real part the identity, imaginary part zero, distinguished imaginary element zero, and the identity real algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides normed and inner product structures on ℝ; introduces no complex variable or additional state component.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The distinguished real zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Sets the initial time and the asserted characteristic derivative to zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "A fixed measure-space instance on ℝ, supplied here only through inferInstance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the measure μ for every integral and integrability condition. Its construction and normalization are not expanded in the packet.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive commutative group equipped with Real.norm and Real.metricSpace, with distance compatible with the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the normed real codomain for the local differential and integral predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real commutative ring with its norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the algebraic and topological structures used in real calculus.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its compatible norm and metric and multiplicative norm law.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the normed field structure underlying every real derivative in the proposition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric structure with distance d(x,y)=|x−y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the usual real topology for limits and differentiability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring instance on ℝ.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring algebra for the scalar-action topology construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a scalar action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the underlying real scalar operation for ContinuousSMul.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the division semiring operations and laws of a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar algebra hierarchy without adding hypotheses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains ring operations, seminorm and pseudometric while omitting the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate real seminormed structure for the calculus instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring structure from a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and topology in the explicit instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts a seminormed ring's pseudometric structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real pseudometric used to obtain a topology for scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication, one, zero and their monoid-with-zero laws from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative scalar structure used by modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid structure from an additive structure with subtraction and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and zero in the scalar-action instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real topology used by differentiability and integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the zero of the supplied Zero instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the target's zero literals the specified real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary addition operation as heterogeneous addition with matching operand and result types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed additions to real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "instHMul",
      "meaning": "Uses an ordinary multiplication operation as heterogeneous multiplication with matching types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves the displayed products to real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The real numbers form a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity facts used to construct the scalar multiplication continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation of a heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines x−speed·t, the difference of spatial integrals and the ordered boundary-flux difference.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative additive group equipped with a norm and its compatible metric structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Is a structural parameter of the generic local definitions, instantiated by ℝ in this target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group structure from a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides subtraction and additive operations used by interval integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A vector space over a normed field whose scalar multiplication is compatible with the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real vector space structure required by the generic derivative and integral definitions; the target specializes to E=ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Real subtraction is defined by a−b=a+(−b).",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the sign of the translated coordinate x−speed·t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure from a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the topology needed by local derivative and integral predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts subtraction from an additive structure with subtraction and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies subtraction of values and integrals in the local conservation predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses ordinary subtraction as heterogeneous subtraction with matching types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves subtraction in the translated profile and integral identities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The oriented interval integral is the measure-theoretic integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], with the supplied measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conservation identity applies to arbitrary endpoint order, with sign reversal on reversing endpoints and zero integral when endpoints coincide.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Constructs a SubtractionCommMonoid from an additive commutative group, retaining its subtraction and negation operations and corresponding laws.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the zero and subtraction hierarchy used in the local differential predicate; it introduces no division operation into the equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition for the sum of the two derivative terms.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains associative commutative addition from an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the addition used in the local differential equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and commutativity from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate interface for addition of derivative values.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
